CICIDS2017.rationale: Daily MachineLearningCSV files represent collection windows and attack campaigns; keep file/day boundaries available for leakage-aware validation.

Edge-IIoTset.rationale: Prepared ML CSV is selected for tabular P1; frame.time/ip fields are metadata for ordering and behavior generation, not direct predictors.

BoT-IoT.rationale: Large partitions and stime/ltime require chunk-safe chronological planning.

N-BaIoT.rationale: Device identity is a domain/group variable, not a direct model input.
